answer: The president of the University of Pennsylvania (where Donald Trump, TIME's 2024 Person of the Year, completed his undergraduate studies at the Wharton School) is **J. Larry Jameson**. He earned his bachelor's degree at the **University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill**, where he received a Bachelor of Science with a major in chemistry with honors in 1976.
